name: landing-page-generator
cost: Free for personal, education and internal business use (MIT + Commons Clause)
works_with: Claude desktop app, Claude Code; Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, Goose and Aider through its npx installer
short: Plans and builds a landing page with PAS, AIDA or BAB copy, a CTA plan and SEO meta, then checks it with three Python tools.
what: The skill first settles a single goal for the page, the audience, the main pain point and the traffic source. It picks a copy framework, builds the sections in a set order from hero to final CTA, and runs a conversion checklist. Three bundled scripts check the HTML: a CTA analyzer, a 22-point conversion audit and a page speed estimate.
who: Marketers and founders building a campaign or lead capture page. The skill does not write the full page copy and does not set up ads or analytics. Skip it if you need those.
needs: An AI tool from the list, or Node 18+ for the npx installer
Python 3 to run the checking scripts
Your offer, audience, key pain point, key benefit and traffic source

steps.title: Add the marketplace in Claude Code
Install the set you need
steps.text: The README lists `marketings` as the set for growing traffic and sign-ups.

steps.title: Or use the Claude desktop app
steps.text: Open Customize, then Browse plugins, and enter `borghei/Claude-Skills`. Every skill is then available.

steps.title: Or use another coding agent
steps.text: Run `npx @borghei/claude-skills add` with the skill name to put one skill in the right folder for your assistant. Find skills with `npx @borghei/claude-skills search`. Needs Node 18+.

steps.title: Check the finished page
steps.text: All three should exit 0 before launch.
steps.code:
python3 marketing/landing-page-generator/scripts/cta_analyzer.py page.html
python3 marketing/landing-page-generator/scripts/conversion_checklist.py page.html --format json
python3 marketing/landing-page-generator/scripts/page_speed_estimator.py page.html

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: "Build a landing page for my free trial offer. The audience is small agency owners, the traffic comes from an email, and the main pain is slow client reporting."

watch: The scripts cannot tell real proof from invented proof. Check by hand that every logo, quote and count comes from you.
The licence is MIT with the Commons Clause, so it can't be sold or repackaged as a paid product.
Its benchmark of a 6.6% conversion rate is a median across all industries. The skill itself says results vary a lot by industry and offer.
